nodes.label: Dummy Image Placeholder (1200x800)
nodes.description: A standard gray placeholder/dummy image measuring 1200x800 pixels. The image has a solid light gray (#cccccc) background with the dimensions '1200 x 800' displayed in dark thin-weight text at the center. Used as a fallback image in the KFV Freising TYPO3 sitepackage when no actual content image is available.
